title: `[@unboxable]` on the result of a recursive function makes its recursive call not a tail call
summary: A function marked `[@unboxable]` that calls itself last does not run in constant stack at the default level, `-O2` and `-O3`: the recursive call goes through the stub that boxes the result. `-Oclassic` ignores the attribute.
cause: `middle_end/flambda2/from_lambda/closure_conversion.ml` makes the code with the unboxed result and a stub that boxes it; in that code the recursive call is a call of the stub, and its continuation unboxes the result instead of returning.
reference: related: PR #7810 (closed without merging) reports the same lost tail call
